original_facts: StatsView constructs a TabbedMDI and a String data source selects an entry by ID; TYPE_CREATE prevents destroy-on-deactivate and TYPE_DESTROY disposes the parent/update thread.
TransferStatsView stores its selected History span/offset as view fields and uses the span combo and previous/next controls to change navigation.
native_scope: A bounded native adaptation: remember only scalar navigation on closing the Qt tab within one profile session. Do not claim original SWT/MDI persistence equality.
Recreate widgets and perform existing fresh saved reads; retain no widgets/results/history cache in the navigation value.
Clear closed-tab memory on accepted session advancement; keep existing visible-page reset semantics and all accounting/worker/reader behavior.
limits: No original Java execution, live-profile switching, resource-performance or full-client parity is established.
